projects.title: Aadhya Self Drive — Flutter iOS & Android
implementation: Flutter app for iOS and Android from a single codebase
Booking flow with location-based search, flexible rental durations, and trip management
TestFlight and Play Store release pipeline with store listing assets and version updates
Monetization through in-app booking and payment flows tied to the rental backend
projects.brief: Ship a cross-platform mobile app for self-drive car rental — browse vehicles, verify renters, book trips, and accept payments on iOS and Android from one Flutter codebase, with App Store and Play Store release.

projects.title: CabinetSense — SaaS platform & RAG assistant
implementation: Refactored support board from JSP to lazy JSON APIs with batch Datastore loads
FastAPI RAG on Cloud Run: Pinecone retrieval, Cohere rerank, MMR, multi-LLM routing
JWT auth, FastSpring licensing, BigQuery nightly export for AI usage and feedback
projects.brief: Modernize support operations with Kanban/list ticketing, embed an AI assistant inside SketchUp with usage-based billing, and deploy production RAG over CabinetSense product documentation.

projects.title: RAG knowledge base — internal docs search
implementation: Offline ingestion pipeline: parse PDFs and HTML, chunk with metadata, embed with OpenAI, and upsert vectors into Pinecone
FastAPI search service: embed the question, retrieve top-k chunks, rerank, and generate answers with inline source citations
Admin endpoints to trigger re-indexing, compare retrieval scores, and monitor index freshness after doc updates
projects.brief: Deliver an internal RAG search over B2B SaaS documentation — natural-language queries, semantic retrieval from wikis and PDFs, cited answers, and re-indexing when content changes.

projects.title: Internal copilot — LLM with tools
implementation: RAG layer over Confluence and Notion with function-calling orchestration
Tool adapters for Jira and Slack with scoped credentials
Access controls, prompt guardrails, and request logging for compliance
projects.brief: Build an internal copilot that answers from Confluence and Notion, runs approved Jira and Slack actions, and enforces role-based access with full audit logging.

projects.title: AI Invoice Bot — OCR + LLM extraction
implementation: Tesseract and Google Cloud Vision for OCR preprocessing
LLM parsing pipeline with schema validation and confidence checks
API endpoint and error handling for malformed or low-quality scans
projects.brief: Invoice data was entered manually from photos and PDFs, causing reconciliation errors on party names, totals, and line items and slowing accounting workflows.

projects.title: LLM training pipeline — code review
implementation: Audited Python training code and Docker image build process
Recommended batching, checkpoint strategy, and failure recovery
Documented runbooks for retraining and model artifact versioning
projects.brief: Review and harden SME Careers’ Python/Docker LLM training pipeline — data loading, checkpointing, recovery, and production-readiness for containerized training jobs.

projects.title: GCP Dataflow — Confluent to BigQuery
implementation: Apache Beam pipeline on Dataflow with autoscaling workers
Schema registry integration and DLQ topic for failed records
Cloud Monitoring dashboards and alerting on lag and error rates
projects.brief: Stream Confluent Kafka events into BigQuery in near real time with schema validation, dead-letter handling for bad records, and monitoring for throughput and lag.

projects.title: Hadoop-to-GCP migration
implementation: Inventory of Hive, MapReduce, and Spark jobs with dependency mapping
Rewrote pipelines for Dataproc and BigQuery with phased cutover
Parallel validation runs and documentation for operations
projects.brief: On-prem Hadoop was costly to operate and blocking cloud adoption; batch and streaming jobs had to move to GCP without breaking lineage validation or daily reporting.

projects.title: ML feature pipeline — training & serving
implementation: Feature store patterns with Airflow orchestration
Model registry integration and promotion gates
REST serving layer with monitoring and rollback support
projects.brief: Feature engineering was repeated manually for every training run, with no single path from raw data to versioned models and a production serving API.

projects.title: Data governance & quality platform
implementation: Built an enterprise Data Insight & Data Quality platform for governance workflows
Developed scalable analytics solutions utilizing Spark, Spark-SQL, and Scala
Implemented automated checks for data quality, including null analysis and correlation detection
Contributed to data modeling and architecture discussions, enhancing overall project design
projects.brief: Data quality issues surfaced only when downstream reports failed; stewards lacked automated profiling, null/correlation checks, and governance workflows at scale.

projects.title: Clinical ETL — Crunch & Hadoop
implementation: Designed and implemented end-to-end ETL pipelines using Apache Crunch and Hadoop MapReduce
Built frameworks for cleansing, transforming, and normalizing clinical datasets ingested into HDFS
Developed REST services with Beadledom (RESTEasy) to expose processed data for downstream systems
projects.brief: Clinical feeds landed in HDFS without consistent cleansing, blocking analytics and forcing downstream teams to work from inconsistent raw copies.

projects.title: Portfolio accounting — cache & reconciliation
implementation: Designed and implemented a distributed caching layer with Hazelcast, improving data access latency for portfolio calculations
Built frameworks for data reconciliation, ensuring consistency between cache and database systems
Implemented AppDynamics monitoring agents to proactively manage production system performance
projects.brief: Portfolio reads lagged during market hours and cache layers drifted from authoritative database records, creating reconciliation risk under trading load.

projects.title: Investment bank desktop clients
implementation: Developed rich desktop clients using Eclipse RCP, SWT, and JFace for global investment bank workflows
Implemented XML marshalling and unmarshalling with JAXB to enhance data handling capabilities
Participated in requirement analysis, estimation, and production support for trading operations teams
projects.brief: Deliver Eclipse RCP desktop clients for trading and operations workflows with reliable JAXB XML exchange to backend services and ongoing production support.

projects.title: REST API — partner integrations
implementation: Flask API with OpenAPI 3 documentation and OAuth flows
Rate limits, idempotency keys, and structured error codes
Client SDK samples and partner onboarding runbooks
projects.brief: Expose a partner-facing REST API with OpenAPI documentation, OAuth authentication, rate limiting, consistent errors, and SDK examples for external integrators.

projects.title: Full-stack dashboard — pipeline health
implementation: Flask backend aggregating run metadata and quality signals
Tailwind UI with status cards, filters, and detail panels
Alert hooks integrated with existing notification channels
projects.brief: Pipeline failures were discovered only after checking Airflow, logs, and email separately — ops lacked one view of SLA status, run history, and quality-check alerts.

projects.title: ELK stack — log search & alerts
implementation: Logstash pipelines with parsing rules per service
Elasticsearch cluster sizing and index templates
Kibana dashboards and watcher-style alerts for incidents
projects.brief: Logs were trapped on individual servers; incident response depended on SSH and grep with no centralized search, retention policy, or error-rate alerting.
